whatIsIt.eli5: Spots look at others in the same strip, then think a little on their own.
whatIsIt.simple: Area attention followed by a small MLP (two 1×1 Convs), each with a shortcut.
whatIsIt.engineer: x = x + AAttn(x); x = x + MLP(x), MLP = Conv(dim, dim·r) → Conv(dim·r, dim, act=False).

whyExists.eli5: Looking around plus thinking alone is the standard recipe.
whyExists.simple: The transformer pattern adapted to YOLO12's area attention.

engineer: No LayerNorm; BN inside the Conv projections.
